Archer's Effigy.name: Archer's Effigy
Archer's Effigy.description: Every 7-12 rows, spawn a stone archer with 160 health on your side. Stone archers are immune to ball damage and shoot arrows at enemies, dealing 10-20 each

Baby Rattle.name: Baby Rattle
Baby Rattle.description: Gain 1.5x baby balls, but your aim becomes scattered

Bandage Roll.name: Bandage Roll
Bandage Roll.description: Shoot 1-2 baby balls each time you're healed

Bottled Tornado.name: Bottled Tornado
Bottled Tornado.description: When you catch a special ball, automatically shoot 1-3 new baby balls in random directions

Crown of Thorns.name: Crown of Thorns
Crown of Thorns.description: Destroy the 2 nearest enemies when you are hit from close range

Cursed Elixir.name: Cursed Elixir
Cursed Elixir.description: When a poisoned enemy dies, 10% chance for them to come back as a zombie with 240 health that moves up the board and fights enemies

Diamond Hilted Dagger.name: Diamond Hilted Dagger
Diamond Hilted Dagger.description: Increase crit chance to 20% when hitting enemies in the front

Dynamite.name: Dynamite
Dynamite.description: Every 5-10 rows, spawn an enemy with dynamite attached to them. Destroying them will deal 200-500 damage to nearby enemies

Emerald Hilted Dagger.name: Emerald Hilted Dagger
Emerald Hilted Dagger.description: Increase crit chance to 20% when hitting enemies on their right side

Ethereal Cloak.name: Ethereal Cloak
Ethereal Cloak.description: Balls go through enemies and deal 25% bonus damage until they hit the back of the field

Everflowing Goblet.name: Everflowing Goblet
Everflowing Goblet.description: You can heal past max health at 20% efficiency

Fleet Feet.name: Fleet Feet
Fleet Feet.description: Increase movement speed by 10% and move at full speed while shooting

Frozen Spike.name: Frozen Spike
Frozen Spike.description: When an enemy is frozen, they emit a chill to nearby enemies that deals 10-20 damage

Gemspring.name: Gemspring
Gemspring.description: Every 7-11 rows, spawn a Gemspring. Dealing damage to them causes them to drop an increasing amount of XP gems

Ghostly Corset.name: Ghostly Corset
Ghostly Corset.description: Balls go through enemies and deal 20% bonus damage when hitting them from the side

Ghostly Shield.name: Ghostly Shield
Ghostly Shield.description: Balls go through allies and heal them for 2 health

Golden Bull.name: Golden Bull
Golden Bull.description: Every 7-11 rows, spawn a golden bull with 400 health on your side. Golden bulls accrue 10 gold per minute. They also move up the field, blocking and attacking enemies in the way

Hand Fan.name: Hand Fan
Hand Fan.description: Slow down enemies in the same column as you by 50%

Hand Mirror.name: Hand Mirror
Hand Mirror.description: Projectiles have a 50% chance to reflect upon hitting you, dealing 20-40 damage if they hit an enemy

Healer's Effigy.name: Healer's Effigy
Healer's Effigy.description: Every 7-12 rows, spawn a stone healer with 100 health on your side, which heals you 10 health per minute while it's on the field. Healers are immune to ball damage and move up the field, blocking and attacking enemies in the way

Hourglass.name: Hourglass
Hourglass.description: Balls deal 150% damage, but damage decays by 30% each time they bounce (minimum 50%)

Kiss of Death.name: Kiss of Death
Kiss of Death.description: Charmed enemies have a 10% chance of dying after recovering

Lover's Quiver.name: Lover's Quiver
Lover's Quiver.description: Projectiles have a 40% chance to heal you for 1 health instead of hurting you

Magic Staff.name: Magic Staff
Magic Staff.description: Increase area-of-effect damage (such as earthquake, laser, and lightning) by 20%

Magnet.name: Magnet
Magnet.description: Increase range at which you pick up items and catch balls by 1.0 tiles

Midnight Oil.name: Midnight Oil
Midnight Oil.description: Balls that hit flaming enemies light on fire and deal 10-20 bonus fire damage on the next hit

Pressure Valve.name: Pressure Valve
Pressure Valve.description: Enemies explode on death, dealing 20-30 damage to adjacent enemies

Protective Charm.name: Protective Charm
Protective Charm.description: Gain a shield that blocks the next damage you would receive. Recharges after 60 seconds

Radiant Feather.name: Radiant Feather
Radiant Feather.description: Increases ball launch speed by 20%, but get knocked back a little each time you shoot a ball

Reacher's Spear.name: Reacher's Spear
Reacher's Spear.description: Increase crit chance to 20% when hitting enemies in the same column as you

Rubber Headband.name: Rubber Headband
Rubber Headband.description: Balls start off at 70% speed but increase by 20% each bounce (max 200%)

Ruby Hilted Dagger.name: Ruby Hilted Dagger
Ruby Hilted Dagger.description: Increase crit chance to 15% when hitting enemies in the back

Sapphire Hilted Dagger.name: Sapphire Hilted Dagger
Sapphire Hilted Dagger.description: Increase crit chance to 30% when hitting enemies on their left side

Silver Blindfold.name: Silver Blindfold
Silver Blindfold.description: Increase crit chance to 20% when hitting blinded enemies

Silver Bullet.name: Silver Bullet
Silver Bullet.description: Balls deal 20% bonus damage until they hit a wall

Slingshot.name: Slingshot
Slingshot.description: 25% chance to launch a baby ball when you pick up a gem

Spiked Collar.name: Spiked Collar
Spiked Collar.description: Deal 30-50 to enemies the first time you get into their melee attack range

Stone Effigy.name: Stone Effigy
Stone Effigy.description: Every 7-12 rows, spawn a stone soldier with 200 health on your side. Stone soldiers are immune to ball damage and move up the field, blocking and attacking enemies in the way

Traitor's Cowl.name: Traitor's Cowl
Traitor's Cowl.description: Stone allies can now be damaged by your balls, but you heal 2 health when a ball hits one

Turret.name: Turret
Turret.description: Floats around your character and shoots a baby ball at enemies every 2.0 seconds

Upturned Hatchet.name: Upturned Hatchet
Upturned Hatchet.description: Balls deal 80% more damage after hitting the back of the field, otherwise damage is reduced by 20%

Vampiric Sword.name: Vampiric Sword
Vampiric Sword.description: Each kill heals you by 5, but each shot you take deals 2 damage to you

Voodoo Doll.name: Voodoo Doll
Voodoo Doll.description: Curse has a 10% chance of killing enemies

Wagon Wheel.name: Wagon Wheel
Wagon Wheel.description: Each time a ball hits a wall, it deals 30% extra damage on the next hit

War Horn.name: War Horn
War Horn.description: All baby balls deal 20% more damage

Wretched Onion.name: Wretched Onion
Wretched Onion.description: Deal 6-12 per second to enemies within 2 tiles

Cornucopia.name: Cornucopia
Cornucopia.description: Has the chance to create an additional baby ball each time one spawns

Deadeye's Cross.name: Deadeye's Cross
Deadeye's Cross.description: Creates a new weapon with greater accuracy and improved critical damage

Gracious Impaler.name: Gracious Impaler
Gracious Impaler.description: 5% chance to insta-kill an enemy with each critical hit

Odiferous Shell.name: Odiferous Shell
Odiferous Shell.description: Improved armor, debuff resistance, and defense

Phantom Regalia.name: Phantom Regalia
Phantom Regalia.description: Balls phase through enemies, dealing 50% more damage

Soul Reaver.name: Soul Reaver
Soul Reaver.description: Each kill grants 1 HP and you can overheal by 30%

Wings of the Anointed.name: Wings of the Anointed
Wings of the Anointed.description: Movement and ball speed buffed by 20% and 40% respectively. Also grants immunity to environmental hazards
